slides.title: OmniTacTune: Policy-Agnostic Real-World RL for Tactile Residual Adaptation of Visual Policies
slides.tldr: TACTILE RESIDUAL ADAPTATION FOR VISUAL POLICIES
slides.highlight: OmniTacTune introduces a policy-agnostic RL pipeline that uses tactile feedback to provide residual corrections to pretrained visual policies. This approach significantly improves success rates in contact-rich manipulation tasks through efficient online interaction.

card.one_liner: OmniTacTune adapts tactile feedback to pretrained visual policies via a two-stage real-world residual RL pipeline.
card.key_idea: A policy-agnostic framework that warm-starts tactile encoders/critics using base-policy rollouts, then learns a lightweight tactile residual policy for contact-aware corrections on frozen visual policies.
card.evaluation: Tested on four contact-rich tasks; improved success rates from 5–40% to 85–100% within 40–80 minutes, outperforming PLD and ViTAL baselines.
card.limitation: Requires manual resets and risks hardware wear from repeated contact-rich interactions, particularly with fragile vision-based tactile sensors.

slides.title: Feeling the Unexpected: ResTacVLA for Contact-Rich Manipulation via Residual Tactile Representation
slides.tldr: RESIDUAL TACTILE REPRESENTATION FOR VLA MODELS
slides.highlight: ResTacVLA addresses modality collapse in Vision-Language-Action models by using residual tactile representations to prioritize surprising physical stimuli over predictable visual cues.

card.one_liner: ResTacVLA integrates tactile feedback into VLA models using residual representations to prevent visual modality collapse.
card.key_idea: A Cross-Modal Predictor extracts tactile residuals (discrepancies between visual priors and sensations), discretized into VQ Latent Contact Primitives and adaptively gated by visual uncertainty.
card.evaluation: Evaluated on five real-world contact-rich tasks; outperformed $\pi_{0.5}$ and Diffusion Policy baselines with a 62.8% average success rate.

slides.title: Closing the Reality Gap: Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Deployment for Dexterous Force-Based Grasping and Manipulation
slides.highlight: This work demonstrates zero-shot sim-to-real transfer for dexterous hands using dense tactile feedback and joint torque sensing. It is relevant to MOSAIC's focus on physics and force-based skill acquisition and human-level manipulation capabilities.

card.one_liner: Achieves zero-shot sim-to-real transfer for force-controllable dexterous grasping and in-hand object rotation.
card.key_idea: Combines fast distance-field tactile simulation, current-to-torque calibration, and randomized actuator dynamics with an asymmetric actor-critic PPO pipeline using dense tactile and torque feedback.
card.evaluation: Evaluated on a 12-DoF XHand via force-tracking and cube rotation tasks; 6D orientation and tactile feedback significantly improved success rates over baselines.

slides.title: SoftVTBench: A Safety-Aware Visuo-Tactile Benchmark for Physically Constrained Robotic Manipulation of Deformable Objects
slides.tldr: SAFETY-AWARE VISUO-TACTILE BENCHMARK FOR DEFORMABLE OBJECTS
slides.highlight: SoftVTBench introduces a benchmark that evaluates both goal success and physical safety in deformable object manipulation, demonstrating that tactile sensing improves safety and reduces object deformation.

card.one_liner: A visuo-tactile benchmark for deformable object manipulation that evaluates both task success and physical safety.
card.key_idea: Uses FEM-simulated objects in Isaac Sim to measure 'Safety Success' via privileged deformation states, contrasting visuo-tactile policies against vision-only baselines.
card.evaluation: Evaluated using $\pi_{0.5}$ baselines across four task suites (rigid/soft, object/spatial). Results show tactile sensing significantly improves Safety Success on deformable tasks.
card.limitation: Limited set of assets and task variations; simulation may not fully capture real-world soft-body dynamics.

slides.title: GelNeuro: A Sensing-Computing Integrated Neuromorphic Tactile System for Texture Recognition
slides.highlight: GelNeuro integrates a visuo-tactile front end with a neuromorphic SoC to achieve high-accuracy texture recognition with significantly lower power consumption than CPU/GPU baselines.

card.one_liner: GelNeuro is a sensing-computing integrated neuromorphic system for ultra-low-power, low-latency robotic texture recognition.
card.key_idea: Directly interfaces a GelSight Mini optical front end with a Speck2f SoC, using a hardware-aware weight-clamping SCNN to eliminate host-computer preprocessing.
card.evaluation: Tested on 15 natural textures; achieved 96.3% accuracy within 80ms using 19.6mW power. Validated via hardware-in-the-loop and cross-depth generalization tests.
card.limitation: Fixed-point 8-bit quantization and BPTT training memory overheads cause a precision gap compared to full-precision software simulations.

slides.title: Current as Touch: Proprioceptive Contact Feedback for Compliant Dexterous Manipulation
slides.tldr: PROPRIOCEPTIVE CONTACT FEEDBACK VIA MOTOR CURRENT
slides.highlight: This research introduces a framework that uses motor current and joint states to predict compliance reference positions, enabling dexterous manipulation without external tactile or force sensors.

card.one_liner: A proprioception-driven framework enabling compliant dexterous manipulation using motor current as a tactile-like contact signal.
card.key_idea: Predicts a Compliance Reference Position (CRP) from motor current and joint states, allowing standard PD controllers to induce appropriate grasping forces without external sensors.
card.evaluation: Tested on LEAP Hand and Dex3 across four tasks (cup stacking, board wiping, card picking, bottle holding); results show improved stability and success rates.
card.limitation: Performance depends on hardware transmission design, current measurement quality, and the quality/coverage of human teleoperation demonstrations.

slides.title: Deform360: A Massive Multi-view Visuotactile Dataset for Deformable World Models
slides.tldr: LARGE-SCALE VISUOTACTILE DATASET FOR DEFORMABLE OBJECT WORLD MODELS
slides.highlight: This work introduces a multi-view visuotactile dataset and 3D tracking pipeline for deformable objects, supporting the MOSAIC goal of estimating procedural and tacit skills through ego-exo views and physics-based observations.

card.one_liner: Deform360 is a large-scale visuotactile dataset for benchmarking 2D and 3D deformable object world models.
card.key_idea: A dataset of 198 objects and 1,980 sequences using 41 cameras and tactile grippers, paired with a markerless 3D tracking pipeline for dense particle annotations.
card.evaluation: Compared 2D video models (Cosmos) vs 3D particle models (ParticleFormer, PGND, PhysTwin) using PSNR, SSIM, and Chamfer distance across frame, episode, and object generalization.
card.limitation: Tracking quality degrades under heavy self-occlusion, and the tactile no-slip regularizer may over-constrain particles during visible slip events.

slides.title: Lift3D-VLA: Lifting VLA Models to 3D Geometry and Dynamics-Aware Manipulation
slides.highlight: Lift3D-VLA introduces a framework that integrates explicit 3D point cloud reasoning and temporal action modeling into VLA models to improve spatial reasoning and physical dynamics. It demonstrates higher success rates across simulated and real-world manipulation tasks compared to prior VLA methods.

card.one_liner: Lift3D-VLA enhances VLA models with explicit 3D point cloud reasoning and temporally coherent action generation.
card.key_idea: Uses a 2D-lifting strategy for 3D encoding, Geometry-Centric Masked Autoencoding (GC-MAE) for physical dynamics, and layer-wise LLM decoding for temporally consistent action chunks.
card.evaluation: Evaluated on 22 simulated (MetaWorld, RLBench) and 8 real-world tasks; outperformed prior VLA methods by 10.8% and 11.1% in simulation.
